stemMd: What conflict did the feasibility study identify?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The market operated only after the venue closed

options.label: B
options.textMd: The venue lacked any possible indoor capacity

options.label: C
options.textMd: The warehouse roof had already collapsed

options.label: D
options.textMd: The building had no connection to surrounding streets

options.label: E
options.textMd: Evening events overlapped with market loading operations

explanationMd: The study identified a temporal and access conflict between the proposed events and adjacent market logistics. This differs from a structural incapacity of the warehouse itself.

distractorRationale.d: Shared access routes created the conflict.
distractorRationale.b: Physical capacity was not the stated problem.
